value.rationale: Abelian-square occurrence is a standard meaningful repetition statistic. Universality forces local factors but not long Abelian-square behavior. The first 2048-cycle order has a complete nontrivial 71-value distribution, exact eleven gaps, sharp and symmetry-rigid extremes, and rational moments; the all-order short-factor identity explains its distinct-factor interpretation. The answer is natural exact finite classification, not a routine parameter substitution.
